title: Ship a side project in one weekend

slides.heading: Ship a side project in one weekend
slides.subtitle: Four steps. No new frameworks.

slides.heading: Cut the idea until it fits
slides.body: Write the one sentence a user would say to a friend. Everything not in that sentence is version two.

slides.heading: Build the boring middle first
bullets: The part that must work, before the part that must look good
Hard-code anything you can replace later
No accounts, no settings, no dashboard
One happy path, end to end

slides.heading: Use it yourself before you show it
slides.body: Ten minutes as your own first user finds more than an hour of reading the code will.

slides.heading: Ship it unfinished
slides.body: A weekend project that exists beats a month-long one that does not. Replace this text and go.
